paper.title: Mask Scoring R-CNN
paper.publisher_section_read: section3.2 indexed original text; direct PDF returned403

verified_facts: Quality feature extractor pools the corresponding predicted mask and concatenates it with instance features before spatial convolutions.
The quality target is detached mask IoU for positive labels with L2 regression.
The official inference implementation creates mask_scores by multiplying detection score and estimated mask IoU.
scope_for_this_project: Only the actual-mask-conditioned quality-estimation principle is a possible next design; original score rescaling conflicts with this study's frozen scores and will not be copied.
